part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that `Object3D.toJSON` never serialized the `up` vector, so `ObjectLoader` always fell back to the default `(0, 1, 0)`.

Changes:
- src/core/Object3D.js:742 — add `object.up = this.up.toArray()` to the standard serialization
- src/loaders/ObjectLoader.js:985 — restore it via `object.up.fromArray( data.up )` during parse

Validation:
- `npm run test-unit`: 2772 tests, `# fail 0` (previously the `Object3D > toJSON` test failed on the baseline)
- Round-trip check with a non-default `up.set(1, 0, 0)` camera now deserializes to `[1, 0, 0]`
- `npm run lint` passes
